lane_doc.all: Every candidate in the universe. The fully open slider.
lane_doc.no_glue: Hide anything our own classifier calls glue (logic-only declaration or apparatus machinery). The classic V8 view. Nothing is deleted from the ranking -- it is hidden from the display.
lane_doc.theorems_defs: Only theorems and definitions/constructions; hides constructors and recursors.
lane_doc.introduced_only: Only citations the proof introduces, hiding anything already implied by the theorem's own statement.
lane_doc.theorems_only: Only cited theorems. The narrowest lane.

rankings.name: B0_random
rankings.doc: Uniform random order within each proof. The floor.

rankings.name: B1_reverse_depth
rankings.doc: Shallowest cited declaration first: the anti-ranking.

rankings.name: B2_popularity
rankings.doc: Most globally cited first. Tests 'importance = citation count'.

rankings.name: B3_term_order
rankings.doc: Order of first occurrence in the record: a structural arbitrary order.

rankings.name: O_source
rankings.doc:
SourceOracle: identifiers the human wrote first, then depth.

    NOT a keyness oracle (audit item 2). It is an upper bound for
    Source* metrics only, and its ceiling below 100% measures CANDIDATE
    COVERAGE, not ranking quality.

rankings.name: R_depth
rankings.doc: Deepest cited declaration first. The simplest real candidate.

rankings.name: R_introduced_depth
rankings.doc: Citations the proof introduces first, then deepest. Current leader.

rankings.name: R_phase5_composite
rankings.doc: Frozen as a weak comparator: role x statement x depth x idf.

rankings.name: R_v8_all_kinds
rankings.doc: V8's demotions, but declaration kind ignored so definitions compete.

rankings.name: R_v8_faithful
rankings.doc: Frozen V8 order, with what V8 filtered merely ranked last.
